Tateyomi 0.0.17 (release build, R8 minified)

This APK is signed with the local Android debug keystore so it can be
installed for testing. It is not suitable for store distribution; create a
proper release signing key for that.

Install:
  adb install -r tateyomi-0.0.17-debugsigned.apk

The APK does not contain any books. Add EPUB, XHTML, CBZ / CBR, or
MOBI / AZW3 files from the library screen. ZIP / RAR / 7z archives of
books can be imported together. Books can also be sent to Tateyomi from
another app's share menu. The androidTest seed assets are not part of
this APK.
